style.styleTitle: First Christmas Safari Animals Personalised Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: An adorable personalised first Christmas bauble containing a safari scene and personalised with the new arrival’s details. The design includes a giraffe, elephant and zebra that are individually cut from wood and printed with the illustrated design before assembling inside the bauble. The animals are nestled beneath a tree that is printed with the personalised details. To customise the bauble, enter the text exactly as you would like it to appear for each of the three lines printed on the tree. The first line will be printed in a script font and is ideal for the child’s name, the second line will be printed in a sans serif font and is the perfect space for the date of birth and weight. Finally there is a third line in the script font for an additional message, such as “First Christmas 2023”. The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10cm and is finished with a loose dusting of artificial snow inside.
